invariants.description: FIFA Futsal Laws 2025-26 Notes: for youth futsal, national FAs may modify the duration of the two equal periods of the game (and two equal periods of extra time). period_duration_ms uses Law 7.1 (20 minutes) as parent baseline when a competition elects unmodified duration.
FIFA Futsal Laws 2025-26 Notes: for youth futsal, pitch size, ball size/weight/material, and goal dimensions (post width / crossbar height) may be modified by the responsible FA/confederation/FIFA.
FIFA Futsal Laws 2025-26 Notes and Law 12/16 references: where outlawed by domestic youth rules, the goalkeeper may not throw the ball directly over the halfway line.
Parent FIFA Futsal Law 3.1 still applies unless FIFA grants other permission: maximum five players including goalkeeper; minimum three to start or resume.
